title: Identification of contributing genes of Huntington's disease by machine learning.
summary: Primary BMC Medical Genomics Methods/Results use postmortem prefrontal expression from 157 Huntington disease and 157 controls; four ML models identify 66 candidate associated genes. Interpretation is transcript association, not causal gene discovery; source does not report functional validation. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
